pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large polyhedral patches with distinct pixel-level edge transitions and high angularity. Individual dark regions are primarily irregular quadrilaterals and pentagons with large relative spatial area relative to the interstitial lines.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Interconnected network of light-toned pathways forming a continuous topological grid. Junction nodes primarily consist of tri-radial and quadri-radial intersections with uniform pixel thickness across the neck and flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Mane displays a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated 1D profile against the background. The silhouette consists of a continuous sequence of small vertical projections along the dorsal neck line.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple small avian organisms (likely oxpeckers) are perched on the dorsal ridge and neck area, creating localized silhouette disruptions.
